title: tanacetum tatsienense
intro: Tanacetum tatsienense, commonly known as Tianshan wormwood or Chinese tansy, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, headache, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum tatsienense include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as parthenolide, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
